input.quote: iii. Licensor hereby, subject to the terms and conditions of this Agreement and provided that Licensee makes payments to Licensor as required under this Agreement, grants to Licensee a non-exclusive license to utilize Licensed Technology solely in the Field of Use and subject to the additional restrictions set forth below and otherwise in this License Agreement.
input.rationale: The grant in p0030 runs to Licensee alone, and the restrictions confine access to "the employees of the Licensee" (p0045), bar third-party use or sublicensing without consent (p0041, p0042, p0085) and bar assignment without Licensor's consent (p0149) — so our Affiliates and contractors are excluded with no path to add them. In addition, Article IV (p0049) lets Licensor immediately terminate the licence upon "any breach" of any covenant with no materiality threshold or cure period, which makes the licence effectively revocable at Licensor's discretion. Our redline extends the grant to Affiliates and contractors acting on our behalf (subject to Field of Use and confidentiality), permits assignment to a successor in an M&A transaction, and limits Licensor's revocation right to material breach uncured after 30 days' notice.

proposal.summary: Extend licence grant to Licensee's Affiliates and contractors, permit assignment to a successor, and limit revocation to uncured material breach
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We have extended the grant to cover our Affiliates and contractors acting on our behalf and to permit transfer to a successor in a merger or sale, since our licences must be usable across our group and survive corporate reorganisations. We have also conditioned Licensor's termination right on a material breach that remains uncured after notice, so the licence is not effectively revocable at will; as a fallback we can accept Affiliate coverage on written notice to Licensor.

ops.oldText: Upon any breach by Licensee of any representation, warranty, covenant and/or obligation hereunder, the Licensor may immediately terminate this Agreement and prohibit the Licensee's use of any and/or all of the Licensed Technology.
ops.newText: Upon any material breach by Licensee of any representation, warranty, covenant and/or obligation hereunder that remains uncured thirty (30) days after Licensor's written notice describing such breach in reasonable detail, the Licensor may terminate this Agreement and prohibit the Licensee's use of any and/or all of the Licensed Technology.
